snippet.title: FNAF: Management Wanted | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
🐻 Welcome to Five Nights at Freddy's: Management Wanted!
The Minecraft mod that brings together the world of Five Nights at Freddy's with a blocky style!  

FNAF: Management Wanted Includes animatronics, decorations, various systems/mechanics, and survival mode compatibility!
